verdict.rationale: Smithery's Triggers feature lets an MCP server surface upstream events which Smithery proxies to a consumer, hinting at event-driven automation, but there is no evidence of a scheduler, persistent background execution engine, or the platform itself running autonomous tasks — automation actually running requires an external agent that consumes the trigger. missing for 10: evidence of a scheduling/cron mechanism, autonomous execution loop hosted by Smithery, and confirmation that triggers fire without an active client agent.
